data.text:
🚦 TRAFFIC ADVISORY | IPL 2026 – SRH 🆚 RCB 🏏

In view of the IPL 2026 match between #SRH and #RCB at the Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium, Uppal on 22-May-2026, moderate traffic congestion is expected from 12:00 PM to 12:00 AM in and around Uppal, Habsiguda, Nagole, Ramanthapur, Boduppal & Amberpet routes.

🚛 Diversions will be in place for heavy vehicles including lorries, tippers, tankers, private buses, tractors, JCBs, etc.

⚠️ Citizens are advised to:
✅ Avoid Uppal Junction and surrounding congested routes
✅ Use alternative routes & ORR wherever possible
✅ Prefer Metro Rail 🚇 and RTC buses 🚌
✅ Follow traffic diversions and parking instructions

🅿️ Spectators are requested to use designated parking areas only.

📍Pass Holders Parking:
• A Ground Parking (Entry through Gate 1A only)
https://t.co/vhLGp1HIZT

📍General Public Parking:

• Penguin Parking Area & TGIALA Parking Area
https://t.co/vOrPjg9QoL

• Open Place of Agarwal (Opp. NSL Building)
https://t.co/PIGuZQ98Xi

• Modern Bakery Parking Area
https://t.co/LpdY8vV3xh

Please plan your journey accordingly and cooperate with Traffic Police personnel for smooth traffic management and public safety.

Interesting divergence playing out globally

Markets linked to the AI trade are massively outperforming

AI linked Markets: South Korea, Taiwan, Japan

Domestic Growth / “Anti-AI” Markets: India, Indonesia, Philippines

Why this divergence?

Korea & Taiwan are directly benefiting from the AI infrastructure boom

Samsung & SK Hynix are riding the HBM memory cycle

TSMC is at the center of AI chip manufacturing

Japan is benefiting through semiconductor equipment & exporters

This is becoming a clear split globally:

AI Asia = Korea, Taiwan & Japan

Domestic Growth Asia = India, Indonesia & Philippines

Interesting part is that even within markets, the rally is becoming extremely concentrated

A handful of AI linked companies are driving entire indices higher

data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements are in place in connection with road restoration work under Nawada Metro Station being carried out by Delhi Jal Board through trenchless method for restoration of a settled sewer line.

The carriageway on Najafgarh–Uttam Nagar Main Road from Dwarka Mod towards Uttam Nagar, between Metro Pillar No. 722 to 723, will remain closed w.e.f. 20.05.2026 (10:00 PM) for approximately 45 days.

Traffic movement is likely to remain affected during the restoration work.

📍 ADVISORY
•Commuters are advised to avoid the affected stretch and use alternate routes
•Plan journeys in advance and allow extra travel time
•Park vehicles only at designated parking spaces

📍 Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels

#DPTrafficAdvisory

Dalawang team ng Swift Traffic Operations Group (STAG) ang nag-operate sa mga sasakyang naka-illegal parking sa Pasay ngayong araw. 

Partikular na pinuntahan ng grupo ang Mabuhay Lane Route 11 at 12 gayundin ang Pasay Tramo; Terminal 1, 2, 3; Andrews Ave.; Ninoy Aquino Ave.; Vicente Sotto St.; PICC; Macapagal Blvd.; at PITX. 

Umabot ng 31 ang nahuli sa non-contact apprehension habang 19 naman sa physical apprehension. Tatlo naman ang impounded.
